candidate_observations.address: Brislington Concourse, Bath Road, Bristol, BS4 5BQ
observed_facts: The property is a leasehold retail parade with 23 shops and one flat and was Sold Prior without a published price.
The published gross rent is £189,227 with four vacant units; the schedule also contains holding-over, tenancy-at-will and break-sensitive occupations.
The property is held from Bristol City Council under two leases with approximately 69 and 71 years remaining at £10,200 total annual ground rent.
A 2023 feasibility study considered 96 flats and eight shops, but the source does not state that planning permission was granted.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Gross rent was not converted into net income; vacant units received no rent, the £10,200 superior ground rent was kept separate, and the feasibility study was not represented as planning permission or development value.

candidate_observations.address: 12-14 Butcher Row and 6-7 Ox Row, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP1 1EP
observed_facts: Costa Limited, company 01270695, is active and pays £63,000 under a ten-year lease from 23 June 2017.
The occupational term ends on 22 June 2027 and no later contracted rent is published.
The first and second floors provide 2,247 square feet of vacant restaurant, office and storage accommodation.
Residential conversion potential is expressly subject to consents; the property was Sold Prior without a published price.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No sale price, post-June-2027 income, upper-floor rent or residential development value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active.
The tenant pays £18,000 under a five-year lease from 24 February 2026 with stated reversion on 23 February 2031.
The property summary states that occupation to 2031 is subject to an option.
The property remains Available and the guide is not published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The option was not treated as exercised or ignored; no guide price, renewal beyond 2031 or rent uplift was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: High Newham Court, Stockton-on-Tees, County Durham, TS19 8PD
observed_facts: The freehold precinct comprises 12 retail units and forms part of a larger complex with 27 residential units on long leases.
The published total rent is £46,334 and the landlord retains rights to manage and insure.
The schedule mixes occupational retail rents, peppercorn interests, £100 residential ground rent and £2,704 from 26 residential flats.
Several occupational rents have annual or periodic open-market/RPI review mechanisms.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £46,334 total was not presented as one long-dated corporate covenant; peppercorn and residential ground rents were separated conceptually, and no future review uplift or guide price was calculated.

candidate_observations.address: Yates, 19-21 Silver Street, Halifax, West Yorkshire, HX1 1HS
observed_facts: Stonegate Pub Company Limited, company FC029833, is an active overseas company.
The tenant pays £131,127 under a 35-year lease from 29 August 1997 ending 28 August 2032.
The lease has no breaks; the 2022 tenant break was not exercised.
The upward-only 29 August 2025 rent review remains outstanding and the property is Withdrawn Prior.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No reviewed rent or 2030 uplift was calculated; withdrawal was not treated as a sale and the unexercised 2022 break did not extend the lease beyond 2032.

observed_facts: The 1,255-square-foot office/live/work maisonette is offered with vacant possession.
The interest is a 999-year virtual freehold from 25 March 1999 at £200 annual rent.
The property includes two bedrooms, a garage and a balcony.
Potential conversion to full residential use is subject to necessary consents; the auction status is Deferred.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No occupational rent, sale price, residential permission or development value was inferred; the £200 superior rent was retained as a cost rather than income.

Any conversion remains subject to planning and Listed Building consent.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No rent, planning permission, completed conversion or development value was inferred from the vacant sale.
